Embassy vs. Online Application

UAE residents have the choice of applying for a Serbian visa either through the embassy or online. When opting for the embassy application, they must complete the online form, print it, and sign it. On the other hand, the online application route also necessitates submitting the printed and signed form, and supporting documents, and paying the fee in cash during the appointed time.

Both methods offer Type C (short stays) and Type D (longer stays) visas based on the purpose of travel. Essential documents include a valid passport, recent photo, UAE residency proof, financial evidence, travel insurance, and accommodation details.

FAQs

Do UAE residents need a visa to visit Serbia?

Yes, most UAE residents require a visa to enter Serbia, unless they hold a passport from a visa-exempt country. However, UAE nationals (Emirati passport holders) can enter Serbia without a visa for up to 90 days within a 180-day period.

How can UAE residents apply for a Serbia visa?

UAE residents can apply for a Serbia visa at the Embassy of Serbia in Abu Dhabi or the Consulate General in Dubai. The application must be submitted in person with all required documents.

What documents are required for a Serbia visa from the UAE?

Typical requirements include:

  • A valid passport (with at least 6 months validity)

  • Completed visa application form

  • Recent passport-sized photographs

  • UAE residence visa (valid at least 90 days beyond the travel date)

  • Proof of accommodation in Serbia

  • Round-trip flight booking

  • Travel insurance covering Serbia

  • Bank statements as proof of financial means

How long does it take to process a Serbia visa in the UAE?

The processing time is usually 5–15 working days, depending on the type of visa and individual circumstances.

Where is the Embassy of Serbia located in the UAE?

  • Embassy of Serbia, Abu Dhabi

  • Consulate General of Serbia, Dubai
